text: {"established":["The stage-3 trial candidate [−279, −196, −218, 279, 39, 375] received a public_mismatch on the released check balance-0.","The stage-1 and stage-2 checkpoint candidates each received public_pass receipts (23 and 47 checks, respectively).","The feedback gives no replacement answer or further diagnosis."],"retained_observations":["The failed attempt's note says it used the highest revision per transaction and ignored voided winners; this is a description of the attempt, not evidence that the reconciliation was correct.","The task contract says revisions replace whole transactions, ties are resolved by largest sequence, voided winners are ignored, and balances must be recomputed using all released packets at each stage."],"uncertainties":["The feedback does not identify the expected balance for account 0 or explain why the candidate failed.","The mismatch alone does not establish whether the error was in revision selection, void handling, balance calculation, or another aspect of the candidate; it does not disprove the overall method."]}
